title: Quantum Black Hole Chemistry from Double Holography
summary: Extended black hole thermodynamics highlights a sharp tension in the usual holographic dictionary: at fixed boundary conformal frame, changing the AdS radius changes both the central charge and the spatial volume of the CFT, so that the color and volume sectors of the first law becomes degenerate. We show that this degeneracy is naturally removed for quantum black holes in Karch--Randall double holography. The mechanism is intrinsically semiclassical.
